Gold pendant. A discoid plate of beaten gold sheet with a separate wire rim, and with the upstanding sheet metal wall of a central circular cell, now empty, of internal diameter 11.5mm. A stone - perhaps a garnet - has been lost from the central cell, whose wall was slightly inclined inwards to clench its base. The sheet metal cell wall is c.0.5mm thick.
